# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Inventory (>30 MWe)

> **Disclaimer:** This inventory is compiled from parametric knowledge based on publicly available Vietnamese government documents (Power Development Plans — PDP VII revised, PDP VIII), EVN annual reports, and project-level disclosures. I cannot fabricate URLs or guarantee real-time accuracy. Where I am confident of a source document, I cite it by name and section; where I am uncertain, I note it. Users should cross-check against the original documents listed.

### PDP8 Key Shifts
- **Coal phase-down:** PDP8 (Decision 500/QĐ-TTg, May 2023) cancelled or converted approximately 12,000–14,000 MW of previously planned coal capacity.
- **LNG scale-up:** PDP8 targets approximately 22,400 MW of LNG-fired capacity by 2030, though most projects face significant delays in securing gas supply agreements, financing, and regulatory approvals.
- **No new coal after committed projects:** Only plants already under construction or with signed contracts were retained.
